empty_today: Nothing planned for today. Add a task whenever you like.
empty_all: A clear space for your ideas.
name: Name
title: Task title
delete_task_body: Subtasks will also be deleted. This action cannot be undone.
delete_list_body: Active tasks: %1$d. All tasks in this list will move to Inbox.
delete_tag_body: The tag will be removed from associated tasks. Tasks will be kept.
error: Could not complete the operation. Try again. A name may already be in use.
local_info: Tasks stay on this device and sync to your Pcix account when cloud is configured. Attached images stay local on this device until a later phase.
discard_body: Your task has not been saved yet.
reminders_disabled: Reminders are off. Due dates remain saved.
notifications_denied: Notifications are blocked: you will not receive reminders.
reminder_inexact: Reminders are on. Android may delay delivery without exact alarm access.
reminder_ready: Reminders are enabled for timed due dates.
notification_explanation: To remind you when this task is due, P©ix needs permission to show notifications. You can still use tasks without granting permission.
exact_explanation: Allow P©ix to schedule exact alarms in Android settings. Without this access, reminders remain enabled but may arrive late.
month_end_policy: If the date does not exist, use the last day of the month. The original date is preserved for later months.
scope_explanation: Which occurrences should change? To change the rule, choose this and following occurrences.
delete_series_explanation: Skip this occurrence and continue the series, or also stop following occurrences. Completed history is preserved.
quick_prompt: What do you need to do or remember?
matrix_urgent_days: Urgent: due within %1$d days, including overdue
matrix_rules_hint: High priority is urgent. Dates and the importance threshold control other automatic classifications. Manual choices take precedence.
matrix_task_hint: Choose Automatic to follow matrix rules, or set each dimension explicitly. Date and priority stay unchanged.
remove_image_body: Remove this image from the task?
dim_lists_hint: Keep these lists visible with muted colors in Home views, except All.
reorder_item: Reorder: hold and drag, or tap for actions
manual_order_hint: Manual order · Hold the handles to move tasks within the same list and date.
invalid_duration: The end must be after the start, within 365 days.
notification_sound_on: Notification sound is enabled. Volume and Do Not Disturb follow your phone settings.
notification_sound_off: This channel is silent. Choose a sound in notification settings.
backup_contents: ZIP archive with tasks, lists, tags, subtasks, repeats and images. Keep it in a safe place.
backup_replace_hint: Restore a P©ix backup, replacing current data after confirmation.
backup_summary: Tasks: %1$d · Lists: %2$d · Tags: %3$d. This replaces all current tasks and related data. Export a backup first if you want to keep them. Appearance settings stay unchanged.
backup_error: Operation failed. Check storage access and that the file is a valid P©ix backup. Existing tasks have not been replaced.
auth_tagline: Your tasks, with a real account when you are ready.
auth_invalid_credentials: Email or password is not correct.
auth_account_exists: An account with this email already exists.
auth_offline: No network. Try again when you are online.
auth_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment.
auth_google_failed: Google sign-in failed. Check connectivity and Google Play services, then try again.
auth_verify_email: If this address can be registered, open the latest confirmation email on this device to return to P©ix. Already confirmed? Sign in.
auth_recover_sent: If the account exists, a reset email was sent.
auth_session_expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
auth_invalid_recovery_link: This password reset link is invalid or expired.
auth_local_store_error: Pcix could not safely prepare the local account data.
cloud_missing_config: Cloud configuration is missing in this build.
legacy_body: We found %1$d tasks, %2$d lists and %3$d tags created before this account. Import them into your account?
logout_body: Pending changes will be sent if the network is available. Tasks of this account will be removed from the device. Appearance settings stay.
delete_account_body: This deletes the Pcix account on the server. The edge function must be deployed. Tasks on this device will be cleared.
sync_offline: Offline — changes stay on this device
google_readonly: Read-only. Pcix does not edit Google events.
widget_empty_week: No activities in the next 7 days
widget_description: Tasks from P©ix, configurable by filter and grouping.
calendar_widget_description: P©ix weekly calendar with tasks for the selected day.
auth_reauthentication_required: Verify your identity before changing the password.
auth_reauthentication_code_sent: We sent a verification code to your email. Enter it below.
auth_same_password: Choose a password different from the current one.
auth_reauthentication_invalid: The verification code is not valid.
logout_pending_body: Sync failed and %1$d local changes are still pending. You can cancel or sign out while keeping a private recovery copy on this device.
account_safety_failed: The local safety copy could not be created or restored. Your data was not deleted.
account_delete_failed_safe: The backend did not confirm account deletion. Local data was not deleted.
google_sync_error: Google Calendar could not be updated. Your saved events remain available.
delete_parent_body: Delete this parent task and keep its child tasks as independent tasks?
auth_email_unconfirmed: Confirm your email before signing in. You can request a new link.
auth_invalid_callback: The confirmation link is expired or cannot be completed on this device. Request a new email here, or sign in if already confirmed.
auth_google_cancelled: Google sign-in cancelled. You can try again.
auth_google_configuration: Google sign-in is not configured correctly for this app. Check the OAuth client and signing certificate.
auth_google_provider: Google sign-in is not enabled on the P©ix server.
auth_google_token: Google credentials could not be verified. Try signing in again.
auth_google_no_account: No Google account is available. Add an account on the device and try again.
sync_schema_missing: Cloud database is not ready. Apply the supplied Supabase migrations, then retry.
sync_forbidden: Cloud access denied. Check the database access policies. Local changes are safe.
sync_invalid_data: Cloud data could not be validated. Local changes remain pending.
sync_enqueue_failed: Could not schedule sync. Try again.
sync_queued: Sync scheduled; waiting for a network connection.
sync_coverage: Cloud sync includes tasks, child tasks, lists, tags and recurrence. Image files and device settings require a local backup.
google_cancelled: Connection cancelled. Tap to choose an account again.
google_configuration_error: Google configuration error. Check the Android OAuth client and enable Calendar API.
google_permission_error: Calendar permissions were not granted. Connect again and allow both Calendar permissions.
google_network_error: Google could not be reached. Check the connection and retry.
google_callback_error: Google returned no authorization result. Try connecting again.
matrix_reorder_hint: Hold and drag a handle to reorder. Tap a card to edit its title and filters.
matrix_custom_hint: Filters replace urgency and importance. A task may appear in more than one card. Lists and tags match any selected item; different categories must all match.
matrix_invalid_range: Choose both dates; the end must not precede the start.
month_filter_hint: These filters apply only to this widget. Select any matching list or tag; different categories are combined. All clears the selection.
month_google_hint: Choose from the calendars connected and enabled in the app. Each account is shown separately.
h_empty: No habits for this day and filter.
h_delete_group: Habits will be moved to No group.
h_interval_help: 1 = daily; 7 = weekly; 14 = every two weeks. Selected weekdays also apply.
h_forever_help: Leave blank for forever. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
h_rule_change: Rule changes apply from today; earlier history is preserved.
h_validation: Check name, dates and positive numbers; select at least one weekday.
h_calendar_legend: ✓ Completed · ◐ Partial · × Missed · – Skipped · · Future. Unscheduled days cannot be checked.
h_streak_help: Streaks count completed scheduled occurrences. Imported history without a known schedule counts consecutive completed calendar days; missing, unknown or skipped days break the streak.
h_delete_warning: Delete this habit and all its history permanently?
h_csv_description: Transfer habits and daily history using a UTF-8 CSV file with semicolon separators: Habit, Date, Total log, Unit, Status, Habit ID.
h_csv_limits: CSV preserves names, IDs, units, counts and recorded states. Frequency, goals, groups and reminders are not included. Use ZIP backup for a complete copy.
h_csv_invalid: Invalid CSV at record %1$d: %2$s. Nothing was imported.
h_csv_error_format: invalid columns or quoting, or file limit exceeded (record 0)
h_csv_error_identity: missing, too long or inconsistent name or ID
h_csv_error_date: invalid date: use YYYY-MM-DD, years 0001 through 9999
h_csv_error_duplicate: conflicting records for the same habit and date
h_csv_future: %1$d records are dated after the device date. They will be preserved and included in statistics when their date arrives.
h_csv_result: %1$d habits created, %2$d records imported, %3$d existing records preserved.
h_csv_summary: %1$d habits and %2$d daily records. New habits: %3$d. Records already present: %4$d.
h_csv_defaults: New habits start with a daily quantity goal of 1 from today; edit it after import. Historical states are preserved. Missing historical dates remain unknown because the CSV does not contain the original schedule. Existing habit settings are kept.
h_csv_replace: Replace records already present on the same day
h_reorder_help: Hold and drag a handle, or tap it to move up or down. Changes are saved automatically. This order applies to all days and groups; completed check habits still appear at the bottom.
h_icon_search_help: Search names or keywords in English, or common habit words in Italian.
h_icon_empty: No matching icons. Try another keyword.
h_chart_scroll: Swipe horizontally to see all dates.
h_chart_mean_line: Dashed line: average of the five displayed periods
h_chart_mean_help: Each bar is the recorded total for a calendar period. Weeks start on Monday. The current period is partial; periods without records count as zero. Future and skipped records are excluded.
h_chart_mean_short: Dashed: average · current period incomplete · missing records: 0
